<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="vi">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Thiệp mời tốt nghiệp</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Alex+Brush&family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,600;1,500&family=Be+Vietnam+Pro:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root{
    --bg-outer:#f8e5ec;
    --bg-card:#fffbfc;
    --ink:#5c3644;
    --ink-soft:#a4788a;
    --accent:#e2a0b7;
    --accent-deep:#c85f84;
    --line:#f3d7e2;
    --shadow: 0 30px 60px -20px rgba(158,63,99,.35);
  }
  :root[data-theme="dark"]{
    --bg-outer:#2a1620;
    --bg-card:#3a1f2c;
    --ink:#f7e4ea;
    --ink-soft:#d9a3b6;
    --accent:#e2a0b7;
    --accent-deep:#f0bccd;
    --line:#4c2636;
    --shadow: 0 30px 60px -20px rgba(0,0,0,.6);
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  html,body{height:100%;}
  body{
    margin:0;
    font-family:'Be Vietnam Pro', sans-serif;
    background:var(--bg-outer);
    color:var(--ink);
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    min-height:100%;
    padding: calc(24px + env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)) 16px calc(24px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));
    overflow-x:hidden;
  }
  .phone{
    position:relative;
    width:100%;
    max-width:390px;
    height:min(780px, 90vh);
    background:var(--bg-card);
    border-radius:32px;
    box-shadow:var(--shadow);
    overflow:hidden;
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
  }
  .floaty{
    position:absolute; inset:0; pointer-events:none; overflow:hidden; z-index:0;
  }
  .floaty span{
    position:absolute;
    opacity:.28;
    color:var(--accent);
    font-size:22px;
    filter: blur(1px);
    animation: drift 9s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  @keyframes drift{
    0%{ transform:translateY(0) rotate(0deg); }
    50%{ transform:translateY(-18px) rotate(12deg); }
    100%{ transform:translateY(0) rotate(0deg); }
  }
  .topbar{
    position:relative; z-index:2;
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between;
    padding:18px 18px 6px;
  }
  .icon-btn{
    width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;
    border:1px solid var(--line);
    background:var(--bg-card);
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
    color:var(--accent-deep);
    cursor:pointer;
    font-size:15px;
  }
  .icon-btn.ghost{ visibility:hidden; }
  .dots{ display:flex; gap:6px; }
  .dots i{
    width:20px; height:4px; border-radius:2px;
    background:var(--line);
    display:block;
    transition:.25s;
  }
  .dots i.on{ background:var(--accent-deep); width:26px; }

  .screen{
    position:relative; z-index:1;
    flex:1;
    display:none;
    flex-direction:column;
    padding:6px 26px 26px;
    overflow-y:auto;
  }
  .screen.active{ display:flex; animation:fade .45s ease; }
  @keyframes fade{ from{opacity:0; transform:translateY(6px);} to{opacity:1; transform:translateY(0);} }

  /* Screen 1: cover */
  #s1{ align-items:center; text-align:center; justify-content:space-between; }
  .badge{
    width:64px;height:64px;border-radius:50%;
    background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--accent),var(--accent-deep));
    color:#fff; display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
    font-weight:700; font-size:15px; letter-spacing:.5px;
    margin-top:6px;
  }
  .script{ font-family:'Alex Brush', cursive; color:var(--accent-deep); line-height:1; }
  .h-grad{ font-size:52px; margin:10px 0 2px; }
  .school-name{ font-size:12px; letter-spacing:2px; color:var(--ink-soft); text-transform:uppercase; margin-bottom:auto; }
  .envelope{
    width:190px;height:130px; margin:18px auto 14px; cursor:pointer;
    position:relative;
  }
  .envelope .body{
    position:absolute; inset:0; border-radius:10px;
    background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--accent),var(--accent-deep));
  }
  .envelope .flap{
    position:absolute; top:0; left:0; right:0; height:70%;
    background:var(--accent);
    clip-path:polygon(0 0,100% 0,50% 62%);
    border-radius:10px 10px 0 0;
    filter:brightness(1.08);
  }
  .envelope .seal{
    position:absolute; left:50%; top:52%; transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
    width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;
    background:#fff; color:var(--accent-deep);
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
    font-weight:700; font-size:13px; box-shadow:0 6px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.15);
  }
  .hint{ font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin-top:2px; }
  .sign-off{ margin-top:auto; text-align:right; width:100%; }
  .sign-off b{ display:block; font-size:15px; }
  .sign-off .yr{ font-size:12px; color:var(--ink-soft); }
  .sign-off .script{ font-size:20px; }

  /* Screen 2: invite */
  .stack{ position:relative; height:150px; margin:8px auto 6px; width:130px; }
  .card-ph{
    position:absolute; top:0; left:0; width:130px; height:150px; border-radius:14px;
    box-shadow:0 12px 24px -10px rgba(0,0,0,.25);
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:26px;
  }
  .card-ph.c1{ background:linear-gradient(160deg,#cdd9e0,#aebfc9); transform:rotate(-10deg) translateX(-14px); }
  .card-ph.c2{ background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--accent),var(--accent-deep)); z-index:2; }
  .card-ph.c3{ background:linear-gradient(160deg,#e3c9c0,#c7a89b); transform:rotate(10deg) translateX(14px); }
  .cap{ text-align:center; font-size:20px; color:var(--accent-deep); margin:2px 0; }
  #s2 h1{ text-align:center; }
  .invite-line{ text-align:center; font-size:14px; color:var(--ink-soft); }
  .name-field{ font-family:'Playfair Display', serif; font-style:italic; color:var(--accent-deep); border:none; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); background:transparent; text-align:center; font-size:20px; width:100%; padding:2px 4px; }
  .who{ text-align:center; font-family:'Alex Brush', cursive; font-size:30px; color:var(--accent-deep); margin:2px 0 10px; }
  .details{ background:#f2f6f8; border-radius:14px; padding:14px 16px; font-size:14px; line-height:1.55; margin:6px 0 12px; }
  :root[data-theme="dark"] .details{ background:#2f1824; }
  .details a{ color:var(--accent-deep); text-decoration:none; font-weight:600; }
  .thanks{ font-size:13.5px; color:var(--ink-soft); line-height:1.6; margin-bottom:16px; }
  .btn{
    border:none; border-radius:12px; padding:14px; width:100%;
    background:var(--accent-deep); color:#fff; font-size:15px; font-weight:600;
    cursor:pointer;
  }
  .btn:focus-visible, .icon-btn:focus-visible, textarea:focus-visible, .name-field:focus-visible{ outline:2px solid var(--accent-deep); outline-offset:2px; }

  /* Screen 3: rsvp */
  #s3 h2{ text-align:center; margin-bottom:2px; }
  .sub{ text-align:center; color:var(--ink-soft); font-size:13.5px; margin-bottom:18px; }
  label.field-label{ font-size:13.5px; font-weight:600; margin-bottom:6px; display:block; }
  textarea{
    width:100%; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:12px; padding:12px;
    font-family:inherit; font-size:14px; resize:vertical; min-height:80px; background:transparent; color:var(--ink);
    margin-bottom:18px;
  }
  .choice{
    border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:12px; padding:12px 14px;
    display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; margin-bottom:10px; cursor:pointer; font-size:14px;
  }
  .choice input{ accent-color:var(--accent-deep); }

  /* Screen 4: thank you */
  #s4{ align-items:center; text-align:center; }
  .photo-lg{
    width:100%; max-width:230px; aspect-ratio:3/3.6; border-radius:16px; margin:8px 0 18px;
    background:linear-gradient(170deg,var(--accent),var(--accent-deep));
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:44px;color:#fff;
    box-shadow:0 16px 30px -12px rgba(0,0,0,.3);
  }
  .thankyou-msg{ font-size:15px; line-height:1.6; margin-bottom:14px; }
  .datechip{ font-size:14px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin-bottom:auto; }
  .final-sign{ margin-top:16px; }
  .final-sign b{ display:block; }
  .final-sign .script{ font-size:22px; }

  .photo-carousel{ position:relative; width:100%; max-width:230px; aspect-ratio:3/3.8; margin:8px auto 6px; border-radius:16px; overflow:hidden; box-shadow:0 14px 28px -12px rgba(0,0,0,.3); cursor:pointer; }
  .carousel-track{ display:flex; height:100%; width:100%; transition:transform .35s ease; touch-action:pan-y; }
  .carousel-track img{ width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:contain; object-position:center; background:#f8e5ec; flex-shrink:0; display:block; -webkit-user-drag:none; user-select:none; }
  .carousel-dots{ display:flex; justify-content:center; gap:5px; margin-bottom:8px; }
  .carousel-dots i{ width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%; background:var(--line); display:block; transition:.2s; }
  .carousel-dots i.on{ background:var(--accent-deep); width:16px; border-radius:3px; }
  .pw-input{ width:100%; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:12px; padding:12px 14px; font-family:inherit; font-size:14px; background:transparent; color:var(--ink); margin-bottom:6px; }
  .pw-error{ color:#c0392b; font-size:13px; text-align:center; min-height:18px; margin-bottom:10px; }
  .wish-card{ border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:12px; padding:12px 14px; margin-bottom:10px; text-align:left; }
  .wish-card .wmsg{ font-size:14px; line-height:1.5; }
  .wish-card .wrsvp{ font-size:12px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin-top:6px; }
  #s5, #s6{ justify-content:flex-start; }
  #wishList{ overflow-y:auto; flex:1; margin-top:6px; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="phone">
  <div class="floaty" aria-hidden="true">
    <span style="left:10%; top:14%; animation-delay:0s; font-size:20px;">♥</span>
    <span style="right:12%; top:26%; animation-delay:1.2s; font-size:16px;">♥</span>
    <span style="left:20%; top:46%; animation-delay:2.1s; font-size:26px;">♥</span>
    <span style="right:8%; top:58%; animation-delay:.5s; font-size:15px;">♥</span>
    <span style="left:14%; bottom:20%; animation-delay:2.4s; font-size:18px;">♥</span>
    <span style="right:18%; bottom:12%; animation-delay:1.7s; font-size:24px;">♥</span>
    <span style="left:50%; top:8%; animation-delay:.9s; font-size:14px;">♥</span>
  </div>

  <div class="topbar">
    <button class="icon-btn" id="backBtn" onclick="prevScreen()" aria-label="Quay lại">←</button>
    <div class="dots" id="dots"><i></i><i></i><i></i><i></i></div>
    <button class="icon-btn" id="shareBtn" aria-label="Chia sẻ">↗</button>
  </div>

  <!-- Screen 1: Cover -->
  <section class="screen active" id="s1">
    <div class="badge" id="secretTrigger">SG</div>
    <div>
      <div class="script h-grad">Graduation</div>
      <div class="school-name">Trường Đại Học Sài Gòn</div>
    </div>
    <div>
      <div class="envelope" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-label="Chạm để mở thiệp" onclick="goTo(2)" onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter')goTo(2)">
        <div class="body"></div>
        <div class="flap"></div>
        <div class="seal">HU</div>
      </div>
      <div class="hint">Chạm vào phong bì để mở thiệp</div>
    </div>
    <div class="sign-off">
      <b>Hoàng Uyên</b>
      <span class="yr">2022 – 2026</span>
      <div class="script">with love</div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- Screen 2: Invite -->
  <section class="screen" id="s2">
    <div class="photo-carousel" id="photoCarousel">
      <div class="carousel-track" id="carouselTrack">
        <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Ảnh tốt nghiệp 1">
        <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Ảnh tốt nghiệp 2">
        <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Ảnh tốt nghiệp 3">
        <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Ảnh tốt nghiệp 4">
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="carousel-dots" id="carouselDots"></div>
    <h1 class="script" style="font-size:34px;margin:0 0 4px;">Graduation</h1>
    <div class="invite-line">Trân trọng kính mời bạn</div>
    <div class="invite-line" style="margin-top:2px;">tới tham dự Lễ tốt nghiệp của</div>
    <div class="who">Hoàng Uyên</div>

    <div class="details">
      📅 Thứ Bảy, 03/10/2026 | 13:00 – 18:00<br>
      📍 Trường Đại Học Sài Gòn<br>
      273 An Dương Vương, Phường Chợ Quán, TP.HCM<br>
      <a href="https://maps.app.goo.gl/QPcSSzq9wPtYC2ZL9?g_st=ipc" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Xem bản đồ chỉ đường</a>
    </div>

    <p class="thanks">Cảm ơn bạn vì đã luôn đồng hành cùng mình trong suốt những năm tháng thanh xuân. Sự hiện diện của bạn trong buổi lễ tốt nghiệp chính là món quà ý nghĩa nhất đối với mình.</p>

    <button class="btn" onclick="goTo(3)">Xác nhận tham dự</button>
  </section>

  <!-- Screen 3: RSVP -->
  <section class="screen" id="s3">
    <h2 style="text-align:center;">Xác Nhận Tham Dự</h2>
    <div class="sub">✧ Cùng đến chung vui nhé! ✧</div>

    <label class="field-label" for="msg">Lời chúc dành cho tân cử nhân:</label>
    <textarea id="msg" placeholder="Gửi vài lời chúc mừng tại đây…"></textarea>

    <label class="field-label">Bạn sẽ đến chung vui chứ?</label>
    <label class="choice"><input type="radio" name="rsvp" checked> Chắc chắn tham dự! 🎉</label>
    <label class="choice"><input type="radio" name="rsvp"> Tiếc quá, bận mất rồi 😢</label>

    <button class="btn" onclick="submitRsvp()">✈ Gửi xác nhận 💌</button>
  </section>

  <!-- Screen 4: Thank you -->
  <section class="screen" id="s4">
    <div class="photo-lg">🎓</div>
    <p class="thankyou-msg">Cảm ơn vì đã đồng hành cùng mình trong hành trình trưởng thành này.</p>
    <div class="datechip">❤️ 03/10/2026 ❤️</div>
    <div class="final-sign">
      <b>Hoàng Uyên</b>
      <div class="script">with love</div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- Screen 5: Private password gate (secret, triple-tap the badge on cover) -->
  <section class="screen" id="s5">
    <h2 style="text-align:center;">Khu vực riêng tư</h2>
    <div class="sub">Nhập mật khẩu để xem lời chúc</div>
    <input type="password" id="pwInput" class="pw-input" placeholder="Mật khẩu" onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter')checkPassword()">
    <div class="pw-error" id="pwError"></div>
    <button class="btn" onclick="checkPassword()">Mở khóa</button>
  </section>

  <!-- Screen 6: Wishes list (only reachable after correct password) -->
  <section class="screen" id="s6">
    <h2 style="text-align:center;">Lời chúc từ mọi người</h2>
    <div class="sub" id="wishCount"></div>
    <div id="wishList"></div>
  </section>
</div>

<script>
  // ---- main 4-screen flow ----
  let mainScreen = 1;
  let activeId = 's1';
  const total = 4;

  function updateChrome(){
    const isSecret = (activeId === 's5' || activeId === 's6');
    document.getElementById('dots').style.visibility = isSecret ? 'hidden' : 'visible';
    document.querySelectorAll('#dots i').forEach((d,i)=> d.classList.toggle('on', !isSecret && i === mainScreen-1));
    document.getElementById('backBtn').style.visibility = (activeId === 's1') ? 'hidden' : 'visible';
  }
  function showScreen(id){
    document.getElementById(activeId).classList.remove('active');
    activeId = id;
    document.getElementById(activeId).classList.add('active');
    updateChrome();
  }
  function goTo(n){
    mainScreen = n;
    showScreen('s'+n);
  }
  function prevScreen(){
    if(activeId === 's6'){ showScreen('s5'); return; }
    if(activeId === 's5'){ mainScreen = 1; showScreen('s1'); return; }
    if(mainScreen > 1) goTo(mainScreen-1);
  }
  updateChrome();

  // ---- RSVP: save the wish locally (this device/browser only) ----
  function submitRsvp(){
    const msgEl = document.getElementById('msg');
    const msg = msgEl ? msgEl.value.trim() : '';
    const checked = document.querySelector('input[name="rsvp"]:checked');
    const rsvpText = checked ? checked.parentElement.textContent.trim() : '';
    try{
      const wishes = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('gradWishes') || '[]');
      wishes.push({ message: msg, rsvp: rsvpText, time: new Date().toISOString() });
      localStorage.setItem('gradWishes', JSON.stringify(wishes));
    }catch(e){ /* storage unavailable, ignore silently */ }
    goTo(4);
  }

  // ---- secret: triple-tap the cover badge to open the password screen ----
  let tapCount = 0, tapTimer = null;
  document.getElementById('secretTrigger').addEventListener('click', function(){
    tapCount++;
    clearTimeout(tapTimer);
    tapTimer = setTimeout(()=> tapCount = 0, 600);
    if(tapCount === 3){
      tapCount = 0;
      document.getElementById('pwInput').value = '';
      document.getElementById('pwError').textContent = '';
      showScreen('s5');
    }
  });

  const SECRET_PASSWORD = 'uyen2026';
  function checkPassword(){
    const val = document.getElementById('pwInput').value;
    if(val === SECRET_PASSWORD){
      renderWishes();
      showScreen('s6');
    } else {
      document.getElementById('pwError').textContent = 'Sai mật khẩu, thử lại nhé.';
    }
  }
  function escapeHtml(s){
    return String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
  }
  function renderWishes(){
    let wishes = [];
    try{ wishes = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('gradWishes') || '[]'); }catch(e){}
    document.getElementById('wishCount').textContent = wishes.length + ' lời chúc';
    const list = document.getElementById('wishList');
    if(wishes.length === 0){
      list.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:var(--ink-soft);">Chưa có lời chúc nào trên thiết bị này.</p>';
      return;
    }
    list.innerHTML = wishes.slice().reverse().map(w => `
      <div class="wish-card">
        <div class="wmsg">${escapeHtml(w.message || '(không có lời nhắn)')}</div>
        <div class="wrsvp">${escapeHtml(w.rsvp || '')}</div>
      </div>
    `).join('');
  }

  // ---- photo carousel on the invite screen ----
  const photoTotal = 4;
  let photoIndex = 0;
  const carouselTrack = document.getElementById('carouselTrack');
  const carouselDots = document.getElementById('carouselDots');
  carouselDots.innerHTML = Array(photoTotal).fill('<i></i>').join('');
  function updateCarousel(){
    carouselTrack.style.transform = 'translateX(-' + (photoIndex*100) + '%)';
    document.querySelectorAll('#carouselDots i').forEach((d,i)=> d.classList.toggle('on', i===photoIndex));
  }
  updateCarousel();
  document.getElementById('photoCarousel').addEventListener('click', function(){
    photoIndex = (photoIndex+1) % photoTotal;
    updateCarousel();
  });
  let touchStartX = null;
  carouselTrack.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { touchStartX = e.touches[0].clientX; }, {passive:true});
  carouselTrack.addEventListener('touchend', e => {
    if(touchStartX === null) return;
    const dx = e.changedTouches[0].clientX - touchStartX;
    touchStartX = null;
    if(Math.abs(dx) > 30){
      photoIndex = dx < 0 ? (photoIndex+1) % photoTotal : (photoIndex-1+photoTotal) % photoTotal;
      updateCarousel();
    }
  }, {passive:true});
</script>
</body>
</html>
